## [[...citing packages with `pakret`]{.pakret}](https://arnaudgallou.github.io/pakret/)

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Overview

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="60%"}

Small, focused package with 3<br>{{< iconify andrsrxn:wing flip=horizontal >}}"on--the--fly"{{< iconify andrsrxn:wing >}} functions: 

+ `pkrt()` -- cite R or R package
+ `pkrt_list()` -- cite collection of R packages
+ `pkrt_set()` -- configure settings

:::

::: {.column width="40%"} 

Alternative citation options:

+ [`knitr::write_bib()`](https://pkg.yihui.org/rmarkdown-cookbook/write-bib) 
+ [`papaja::r_refs()`](https://frederikaust.com/papaja_man/writing.html#citations) 
+ [`grateful::cite_packages()`](https://pakillo.github.io/grateful/reference/cite_packages.html)

:::

:::

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false

library(pakret)
```

### `pkrt()`

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

````{r}
```
library(plotly)
library(pakret) #<1>

fig <- plot_ly(data = iris, x = ~Sepal.Length, y = ~Petal.Length, color = ~Species, colors = "Set1")

fig

```

we used `r pkrt("plotly")` for the graph, and `r pkrt("pakret")` for references. 

BUT, we DID NOT use `r pkrt("purrr")`
````
1. note that a .bib file is NECESSARY (functions will fail without a pre--existing .bib file to append to) {{< iconify emojione:books >}}, also packages need to be locally installed (but do NOT need to be used in current project)

::: 

::: {.column width="50%" .smaller}

we used `r pkrt("plotly")` for the graph, and `r pkrt("pakret")` for references. 

BUT, we DID NOT use `r pkrt("purrr")`

::: 

:::

### `pkrt_list()`

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}

````{r}

...we also did not use 
`r pkrt_list("lubridate", 
"devtools", "dygraphs", 
"tinytable")`

````

Note the auto--prose within the listings ("and" placement & "v." vs. "version")

::: 

::: {.column width="60%"}

...we also did not use `r pkrt_list("lubridate", "devtools", "dygraphs", "tinytable")`

::: 

:::

![](https://static.vecteezy.com/system/resources/previews/014/391/904/non_2x/right-arrow-curved-icon-isolated-on-transparent-background-free-png.png){.absolute bottom="0" left="200" height="120" .tilt}

### `pkrt_set()`

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="50%"}

````{r}
pkrt_set(pkg = 
        "the Rrrridiculous package    #<1> 
         *:pkg*                       #<2>
         [Virgin :ver, :ref]")        #<3>


We used `r pkrt("cowsay")`
````
1. "Auto"--prose appended with citation
2. Formatting permitted (here, italicized)
3. more "auto"--prose, mixed with package--specific information (version [`:ver`] and reference [`:ref`]), note the parenthesis specification as well as the comma

...you can control the appearance of the rendering, overriding the defaults

::: 

::: {.column width="50%"}

We used `r {pkrt_set(pkg = "the Rrrridiculous package *:pkg* [Virgin :ver, :ref]"); pkrt("cowsay")}`.

:::
